function.name: open_application
function.description: Open an application on the user's computer

application.description: The name of the application: e.g. pavucontrol, brave web browser, alacritty terminal emulator. The provided application should only be a binary, so it should only be one word, never provide more than one word or application with spaces

file_path.description: If the user specifies a program with a certain input argument, provide the filepath. E.g. 'open my favorite document'-> application: okular  file_path: /home/will/myfavdoc.pdf

function.name: edit_bt_connection
function.description: Connect or disconnect a bluetooth device on this system

device_mac.description: The mac address of the device to be edited

connect_or_disconnect.description: whether or not the device should be connected or disconnected

function.name: media_player
function.description: Change the state of the media player

action.description: Choose a media player action for linux command line utility playerctl. previous is last track, next is next track / skip track.

function.name: print_center
function.description: Change the state of the media player

page_start.description: The first page the user wants to print, if requesting a page range

page_end.description: The last page the user wants to print, if requesting a page range

file_path.description: The file path of the document the user wants to print
